_provenance: The HFT DECISION lowered to a combinational select-DAG, proven ==VM (hft_decision_fabric_lock + iverilog tb_decision_hft, 256 vectors), taped out standalone behind an on-chip BIST harness. Every number below is measured on the netlist the signoff ledger ships (scripts/measure-silicon-power.py) and every ratio derived from those measurements (scripts/record-silicon-power.py).
design: decision_hft (HFT microprice market-making decision + fat-finger clamp + position risk gate)

signoff_clean._provenance: OpenLane Sky130 RTL-to-GDSII of decision_hft_bist.v (LFSR-fed BIST harness, clk/rst/sig only) — signoff-clean at every timing corner, golden sky130A_mr DRC 0. OpenSTA report_power on the post-route RC-extracted netlist at the signoff clock, typical corner, default switching activity.

power_mw.note: decision_selectdag_comb (Combinational group) is the decision; bist_lfsr_misr_seq is the stimulus/signature overhead, not the decision.

vs_soft_core.basis: the SAME decision kernel on the soft-core: 82 cycles at 29.5 mW over its 15 ns clock = 36.28 nJ

signoff_clean.cross_check: cgra_sumto adder-fabric signoff-clean 5.46 mW ~ decision 5.2 mW

vcd_validation._what: VCD-annotated signoff power: real switching activity from a gate-level simulation of the signoff-clean post-route netlist at its signoff clock, fed into OpenSTA report_power. Open equivalent of PrimePower/Voltus.
vcd_validation.design: decision_hft_realbist (decision + realistic market-input stimulus, signoff-clean at every corner)
vcd_validation.workload: on-chip realistic market-input stimulus; 4000 cycles of gate-level simulation deciding buy 523 / sell 833 / risk-blocked 419 / no-trade 2225, signature X-free and equal to its RTL's (92de); 3976 of 4265 design pins annotated

decision_mix._what: every decision latched in the measured window, classified on the RTL: buy (quantity > 0), sell (< 0), risk-blocked (a side chosen, the position limit refuses it), no-trade (no side)

vcd_validation.finding: MEASURED activity draws ~3.6x LESS than the tool's default-activity assumption -> the default-activity numbers quoted elsewhere are CONSERVATIVE upper bounds.
vcd_validation.reproduce: python3 scripts/measure-silicon-power.py decision_hft_realbist   (gate sim -> VCD -> report_power)
vcd_validation.artifacts: post-route netlist + extracted SPEF + PDK Liberty per corner + VCD — all standard, inspectable (GTKWave/PrimePower/Voltus)

multi_corner_mw.note: VCD-annotated power at each PVT corner with that corner's parasitics; ff/tt = 1.14 against (1.95/1.80)^2 = 1.17.

independent_physics_check.verdict: typical-corner VCD switching energy / (V^2 x 3,619,124 VCD rises) = 4.57 fF per net-rise, beside a 3.95 fF SPEF-extracted average net parasitic: the tool's number reduces to first-principles physics.

glitch_power.reason: functional VCD excludes glitch; iverilog SDF timing simulation on the sky130 models is X-pessimistic. Glitch in a shallow, multiplier-free datapath is a small fraction of dynamic power; the default-activity headline already exceeds the measured activity by 3.6x, so a glitch correction cannot flip the conservatism.

second_kernel_cross_check_mw.note: an independent signoff-clean circuit of a different class corroborates the ~1 mW power density.

honest_comparison._correction: The fabric implements the DECISION KERNEL; the fair baseline is the SAME kernel on the soft-core, measured cycle-accurately.

reductions.headline: ~1,122x less energy per operation (conservative block-total basis), measured

honest_comparison.note_core_basis: cycles measured on the full soft-core RTL; power is the scalar-core Sky130 signoff (a smaller instance of the same core family) - using it is conservative (a larger core draws more).
honest_comparison.full_pipeline: NOT claimed. The full tick-to-trade pipeline (866 cyc) needs a divider unit (microprice) and CGRA loop projections (book-keeping) composed with the decision select-DAG - future work; a full-pipeline fabric would only increase the advantage.

cpu_twin._what: the routable scalar LOGOS core, its boot ROM the HFT decision over decision_hft_realbist's input ranges; signoff-clean at every corner, VCD-measured at its signoff clock
